name: uireact-toolkit
description: Superset toolkit baked into the uireact-base Docker image. Installed ONCE at /work/node_modules and shared read-only across every docs-to-react project build. Covers the CANONICAL shadcn/ui (radix) component set generated by `shadcn@4 add` (radix-nova, neutral base color) — NOT a bespoke theme. Per-project package.json lists only the SUBSET it imports; Vite/tsc resolve by path so this superset serves any subset. Bump the version + rebuild the base image (builder/build-base.sh) when adding an allowed dependency (see references/allowed-deps.md).
